precision.completed_instruction_defect_contract: For each completed recursive unitary/COPY step, Hilbert defect <= u times maximum current stream norm. Each real arithmetic primitive has defect <= u times its row norm times that maximum; the envelope charges a factor two when combining the real and imaginary components. All compound ADD coefficients are expanded through an actual owned Horner work row; SCALE and SWAP are expanded to their real primitives. Exact clear/zero allocation writes zero.
precision.sufficient_implication: For every b >= 0 and initial maximum stream norm B >= 0, u <= 2^(-b-guard) gives every-cut error <= B*2^(-b), strictly when B > 0. At B=0 the stated relative-defect contract forces exact zero.
precision.proof: The nonnegative recurrence bounds every ideal state by P*B and every sequence of uniform unit defects by K at every cut. For E the maximum actual error, linear propagation gives E <= K*u*(P*B+E). Since K*u < 1/2, E <= K*u*P*B/(1-K*u). The recorded dyadic guard makes this less than B*2^(-b).
precision.scope: Finite local conditional precision implication only. This is neither a rounded-child implementation nor selected global stock/row or all-size admission.

precision_units: Payload512 is a per-lambda magnitude coefficient, not a fixed bit count. Exact recursive children return Gaussian dyadics without intermediate rounding. Common denominator/magnitude excess is charged separately by C0*d.

exact_fine_grid_contract.completed_child: C_r tensor powers are exact, with Gaussian dyadic denominators 2^(r*f) and coordinate row-sum at most 2^(r*f). No intermediate child rounding.
exact_fine_grid_contract.literal_scope: Fresh literal charge includes every dyadic Horner primitive, private clear, monomial wrapper and route; native monomials introduce only unit Gaussian phases.

optional_rounding_robustness.scope: Separate sufficient feedback implication only, conditional on the explicit local Hilbert-defect contracts in precision receipts. It is not the inherited exact child contract and is not needed for the exact finite invoice.
